platforms.notes: Angular SPA. The collector intercepts its XHR JSON rather than relying on DOM selectors. Some listings on Jadarat require an authenticated Absher / NIC session; those appear as titles without full descriptions and are scored on title + location only.
Primarily hourly / temporary and field roles. Kept enabled because it also carries warehouse, inventory and operations shifts, but expect a lower average match score than the ATS sources.
Requires authentication for most listings; disabled by default.
Emits schema.org JobPosting JSON-LD on listing pages.
